correctness.rationale: Axiom !a⊙!b=!(a∧b) and !a<=1 prove monotonicity. Idempotence !!a=!a and !a⊙!a=!a imply fixed images are subunit multiplicative idempotents; !0=0,!1=1. Monotonicity plus deflation shows each ! is uniquely the floor to an endpoint-containing subset S of idempotents E; conversely such floors satisfy all four bang axioms because ordered subunit idempotents multiply as min. Therefore there are 2^r maps for r=|E|-2. For floors f_S,f_T, if they commute their composition is the floor to S∩T; a block between consecutive shared fixed points with S-only and T-only points produces different composition outputs. Absence of both types on each such block gives the converse. Each gap of length l has 2^(l+1)-1 valid status words, and the sequence-of-gaps generating function is 1/(1-4z+2z²), yielding c0=1,c1=4,c_r=4c_{r-1}-2c_{r-2} and closed form. For nilpotent minimum n, E={0} plus upper indices with 2i>n-1, so r=floor(n/2)-1 and earliest noncommuting n=6; its explicit S,T give two failures among sixteen ordered pairs. Independent enumeration of endpoint-fixed floors on idempotent chains up to size 8 gave commuting pair counts 1,4,14,48,164,560,1912, matching recurrence. The general proof is algebraic, not inferred from finite enumeration.
